_comment: OPTIONAL: overrides for the built-in filegroup->{dir,mode,owner,group} map.
pkg-p2 does NOT set PKG_FILEGROUP_MAP -- the schema-declared default
already covers Binaries64 / Impl_Libraries64 / Config_OS with sensible values.
This file exists purely to show WHAT such an override looks like
when a project's install layout needs to differ.  Point at it with
pkg-p2.mk to try it; the shallow-merge means only the listed keys
change, everything else keeps its schema default.
